lead.event: Yangzijiang Shipbuilding exceeds its order-win target with a record order book
lead.headline: Yangzijiang Shipbuilding exceeds FY2026 order target by 55% with US$6.98 billion in orders
lead.blurb: The 87 vessels ordered in the first 10 months helped lift the undelivered orderbook to US$26.3 billion across 285 ships as of 31 October, with around two-thirds of its value in clean-energy newbuilds. Yangzijiang had delivered 47 vessels, or 81% of its 58-vessel FY2026 target, by the update. It plans to ramp up its Hongyuan yard, which is expected to be fully operational in early 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: Singapore extends GST waiver and launches central bank gold vaulting service
market_structure_policy.headline: Singapore extends wholesale gold GST waiver and launches central bank vault for up to 500 tonnes
market_structure_policy.blurb: The waiver covers wholesale vaulting, refining, assaying and broking between institutional participants, not retail consumers, from April 2027. MAS will offer custody accounts to select Singapore-based bullion banks while SGX Group, DBS, OCBC and UOB develop a clearing system expected ready by end-2026, with live trading expected in 1Q 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: IMDA issues Simba notice over alleged regulatory and spectrum breaches
market_structure_policy.headline: IMDA issues Simba notice with six allegations over regulatory and spectrum breaches
market_structure_policy.blurb: The allegations include unauthorised spectrum use and governance concerns. Simba says services, plans and wallet balances are “100 per cent unaffected” during investigations. Tuas said on 26 October that IMDA had reached no conclusion on action. If proven, the allegations could bring fines, licence suspension or cancellation, or changed licence conditions.

deals_control.event: Hongkong Land acquires and renames Wheelock Place as LANDMARK Orchard
deals_control.headline: Hongkong Land renames Wheelock Place as LANDMARK Orchard after 1.1 billion SGD purchase
deals_control.blurb: Its Singapore Central Private Real Estate Fund bought the 21-storey mixed-use property from Wharf Real Estate Investment Company on 31 July. The renaming took effect on 12 November and marks the first use of Hongkong Land’s Landmark name outside Hong Kong.

deals_control.event: Grab, SoftBank and PETROS agree to fund Malaysia AI infrastructure
deals_control.headline: Grab, SoftBank and PETROS agree to fund US$1.85 billion of Malaysia AI infrastructure
deals_control.blurb: SoftBank Group will be the majority shareholder in the Sarawak project, while Grab will lead the Peninsula Malaysia project as a founding shareholder, with PETROS also investing. The multi-year plan targets at least five gigawatts of AI compute capacity, with deployment staged against development and customer contract milestones as the parties seek additional investors and hyperscaler customers.

deals_control.event: CDL Hospitality Trusts agrees to acquire Moxy Singapore Clarke Quay
deals_control.headline: CDL Hospitality Trusts agrees to acquire Moxy hotel, adding 19% to Singapore rooms
deals_control.blurb: The acquisition is expected to lift CDL Hospitality Trusts’ Singapore room count to 3,030 and its global count to 5,399, while gearing rises from 35.6% to 39.5%. It will be financed through a preferential offering to existing investors and debt, and the hotel is expected to open in 2027. The trust plans to raise payouts from 90% to 100% of distributable income starting 1 July.

deals_control.event: Link REIT agrees to acquire a 50.1% stake in Eastpoint Mall
deals_control.headline: Link REIT agrees to buy 50.1% of Eastpoint Mall for S$239.5 million
deals_control.blurb: Income Insurance will retain the remaining 49.9% interest. Link REIT plans to use internal resources and debt financing, and will become the mall’s asset and property manager after completion, expected in the first quarter of 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Singtel reports H1 results, raises guidance and declares an interim dividend
earnings_guidance.headline: Singtel reports H1 results, raises guidance and declares 9-cent interim dividend
earnings_guidance.blurb: Net profit fell 55% to S$1.54 billion for the half-year ended September, while underlying net profit rose 10% to S$1.49 billion. Singtel raised full-year growth guidance from mid-single digits to mid-to-high single digits, citing double-digit EBIT growth momentum. The dividend is 9 Singapore cents per share, comprising a 7.1-cent core dividend and a 1.9-cent value realisation dividend, payable on 11 December.

earnings_guidance.event: CDL warns of weaker second-half performance as asset disposals are delayed
earnings_guidance.headline: CDL warns of weaker second-half performance as disposals slip, shares fall 8.3%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Disposals planned for 2026 have been postponed until 2027 because of persistent inflation and high interest rates. CDL expects second-half results to be weaker than the profit from the South Beach Consortium sale in 2025, and cited foreign-exchange losses and anticipated property impairment losses.

earnings_guidance.event: ST Engineering reports Q3 results, record order book and interim dividend
earnings_guidance.headline: ST Engineering reports Q3 results with record S$37.7 billion order book
earnings_guidance.blurb: Revenue rose 9% year on year to S$3.4 billion. ST Engineering declared an interim dividend of S$0.05 per share, up from S$0.04 a year earlier, payable on 8 December.

earnings_guidance.headline: Jardine reports mixed nine-month 2026 performance as Astra net profit falls 1%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astra’s net profit fell 1 per cent excluding non-recurring charges, as automotive and financial services earnings rose 8 per cent and 6 per cent while mining and heavy equipment profit fell 28 per cent. In Jardine’s first update since selling Cycle & Carriage to Chandra Asri Pacific for a S$221 million gain in August, it also reported higher profits at THACO and REE.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Sea reports Q3 results and expands share repurchase authorisation
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Sea reports Q3 net income of US$502.5 million, adds US$1 billion buyback authorisation
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Revenue rose 43.4% to US$8.6 billion. Sea had repurchased 11.1 million shares for about US$997.2 million under its US$1 billion programme, and its board approved another US$1 billion for repurchases with no expiry.
